In the eastern quarter at this day there are no Hells; those which were there have been translated to the western quarter in front.

The Hells in the northern and southern quarters are numerous; in these are they who... have been in the love of the world, and thence in... enmity, theft, cunning, avarice, and unmercifulness. The worst Hells of this kind are in the northern quarter... Their direfulness increases according to their proximity to the western quarter...

Behind the Hells in the western quarter are dark forests, in which malignant Spirits wander about like wild beasts. In like manner behind the Hells in the northern quarter. But behind the Hells in the southern quarter are the deserts...
The Hells are ordinately distinguished according to the differences of every evil, so that nothing could be more ordinate and distinct...
There are Hells beneath Hells. Some of them communicate by passages; many by exhalations...
The whole Heaven and World of Spirits are as it were excavated, and under them is a continuous Hell.
On the equilibrium between Heaven and Hell. General article.
From proprium all tend to Hell.
All the Hells act as one... and the Divine alone... can resist all the Hells...
It is continually provided... that no infernal Society beneath a heavenly one shall prevail over it, (Explained.)

The means (of adjusting the equilibrium) are many. Some relate to the stronger presence of the Lord... some to the ejection of superfluous infernal Spirits into the deserts; some to the transference of certain Spirits from one Hell to another; some to the ordination of those who are in the Hells... some to the hiding of certain Hells under denser and grosser coverings: also to the letting down of them to greater depths.
The Hells are continually assaulting Heaven... I have perceived the boilings up of some of the Hells...
As those in the Hells cannot be saved... the outrages in the Hells are subdued as much as possible, and the cruelties are restrained...

The Hells also are distinguished into two kingdoms... The one opposite the Celestial Kingdom is in the western quarter, and its inhabitants are called Genii; and the one opposite the Spiritual Kingdom is in the northern and southern quarters, and its inhabitants are called Spirits...
It is constantly provided... that nothing shall flow forth from the Hells opposite the Celestial Kingdom towards those who are in the Spiritual Kingdom...
No Spirits from Hell itself... are with man. By evil Spirits in the World of Spirits man is conjoined with Hell...
The loves of self and the world make Hell with man...
There is an extension of all affections of evil and falsity into Hell...
Those in Hell, also, have this inmost degree of life...
Every Society... forms three Heavens, and three Hells beneath them...
These doctrinal things had been dictated from the deepest Hell...
Some of the Papists were cast into the Hells of the Gentiles.
A black soil, beneath which is their Hell.
These gulfs, and this sea, are their Hells...
(Position of the Hells of the Reformed.)
The Lord conjoins the Heavens and the Hells by oppositions.
Many... cast hither and thither into gulfs marshes, pools, and deserts, which are so many Hells.
(The subjugation of the Hells by the Lord. Treated of in the Prophets).
(Thus) when man... conquers in temptations, he is drawn out of Hell...
Before the Lord's Advent, the Hells had grown to such a height...
Before the Last Judgment, the power of Hell prevailed over that of Heaven...
But this state of power of Hell was completely broken by the Last Judgment...
Those in Hell... will not hear about God, and cannot name Him.
While in the world, man is between Hell and Heaven; Hell is beneath... If he turns to Hell, he turns away from Heaven...
So long as concupiscences block up the interiors of the natural mind, the man is in Hell...
It is a universal of faith that the Lord came into the world to remove Hell from man... Thus He holds Hell subjugated in order and in obedience to Him to eternity.
The Hells under them are remote according to the rejection of love and wisdom.
The denial of God makes Hell; and, in the Christian world, the denial of the Lord's Divinity.
To turn the back to Him is to turn to Hell.
Hell is divided into Societies according to all the differences of... infernal loves.
The love which is the head, and to which all infernal loves are referable, is the love of dominion from the love of self.
Then... conjunction with Hell takes place.
The sensuous... after death are in Hell.
Then, by no inversion or retorsion, can he be reduced into the opposite state, and thus be drawn out of Hell.
That the natural mind, which is in evils and the derivative falsities, is a form and image of Hell. General article.
That the three degrees of the natural mind, which is a form and image of Hell, are opposite to the three degrees of the spiritual mind... General article.
There are three Hells... distinct according to three degrees of height... the lowest Hell being opposite to the highest Heaven, (and so on).

The loves of self and the world make the inmost degree in the Hells... Folly and insanity... from their loves make the middle degree in the Hells... And the things concluded from their two degrees, which become either knowledges or acts, make the outermost degree in the Hells.
How the goods and truths of Heaven are turned into... the opposites in the Hells. Shown by experiment.
(The inverted position of the Hells. Explained.)
He is dead, whose mind is a Hell.
That evil uses... arose together with Hell. General article.
That all things which are evil uses are in Hell. General article.
Noxious things are produced on Earth by influx from Hell by the same law of permission by which evils themselves inflow thence with men.
That the influx from Hell operates... evil uses in places where there are things which correspond. General article.

The Hells are therefore named from their various stenches. Enumerated... But all these Hells are covered... If they are opened even a little... they excite vomiting and oppressive headaches; and those Hells which are also poisonous cause swoons. Their very dust is of the same nature...

That these Hells have not only communication, but also conjunction with such things in earth, may be concluded from this, that the Hells are not remote from men, but are around them, nay, are in those who are evil; thus they are contiguous to the earths.
The ultimate Spiritual... is separated from its higher degrees in the men of whom Hell consists.
(Thus) it is Hell which produces evil uses.
Hence he who casts down his mind to Hell, is cast down thither whole.
Therefore the universal Hell before the Lord is not only as nothing, but it is utterly nothing as to power...
The Kingdom of the Lord, which is... also over Hell, is a kingdom of uses.
The influx of... Hell is into the love of evil and through these into the and its... concupiscences perceptions and thoughts.
But after they have entered Hell, these filthy delights are turned into direful things.

The man who does not suffer himself to be led to Heaven... is prepared for his place in Hell; for of himself man continually tends to the lowest of Hell, but is continually withheld by the Lord; and he who cannot be withheld, is prepared for a certain place there, to which he is assigned immediately after (death); and this place is opposite to a certain place in Heaven... This is the inmost of the Divine Providence concerning Hell.
The delight of evil, perceived as good, is Hell.

When a man does not will evil because it is from Hell... he is then in the first degree of reformation, and is at the threshold from Hell into Heaven... When he... resolves to desist from evils, he is in the second degree of reformation, and is then outside Hell, but not yet in Heaven...
(The three degrees of light in Hell. Described.)
As all, even the evil, fear Hell...
From his hereditary evil, man is always panting towards the lowest Hell; but the Lord is continually... drawing him out; first to a milder Hell, then from Hell, and at last to Himself in Heaven.
As they then manifestly see the Divine Providence, and from it their final lot, which is that they are to come into Hell, they conjoin themselves with the devils there...
That Heaven and Hell are in such a (human) form. Explained.
That those who have acknowledged nature alone, and human prudence alone, make Hell. Explained.
Self-love has closed the window... lest it should see... that man's proprium is Hell.
Hence it is that all in Hell want to do evil to all...
That these two loves are distinct from each other as are Hell and Heaven. Explained.
All who are in the love of dominion from the love of self are in Hell as to their spirits...
They are therefore in Hell, and are vile slaves there...
From birth man is like a little Hell... and no one can be withdrawn from his Hell by the Lord, unless he sees that he is there, and wants to be led out; and this cannot be done without permissions...
Neither does anyone in Hell think from himself, but from others around him...
Trial was made... with those who believed that the Lord could remove the evils in the evil, and put goods in their place, and so transfer all Hell into Heaven...

For an evil man is Hell in the least form; and Hell consists of myriads of myriads; and everyone there is in form like a man, though monstrous; and all the fibres and vessels in him are inverted; the Spirit himself is evil, appearing to himself as a one; but the concupiscences of that evil are (innumerable)...

The cause of his leading himself deeper into evil, is that he introduces himself more and more interiorly... into infernal Societies... He who has (done this) becomes as it were bound with cords... In the world they are as soft wool... but after death they become hard...
If evils are only in the thought... he is not as yet with his evil in an infernal Society; but he enters it when they are in the will also...
Every evil man is in an infernal Society... and he sometimes appears there, when he is in deep meditation.
All Hell is nothing but the form of all the concupiscences of evil...
That the Lord rules Hell by opposites; and that the evil who are in the world He rules in Hell as to the interiors, and not as to the exteriors. General article.

All in Hell are nothing but concupiscences of evil and the derivative imaginations of falsity; which are so ordinated that (they) are exactly opposite to the affections of good and thoughts of truth in Heaven; and therefore Hell is beneath Heaven, being diametrically opposite to it... as the antipodes are... Sometimes Hell so appears in relation to Heaven... The reason is that those in Hell make the concupiscences of evil the head, and the affections of good the feet...

The delight of his concupiscence infills and surrounds every Spirit of Hell; the general delight, every Society of Hell; and the most general delight, the whole Hell. As the affections of Heaven and the concupiscences of Hell are diametrically opposite to each other, it is evident that the delight of Heaven is such undelight in Hell that they cannot endure it...
That the Lord rules in Hell the evil who are in the world. Explained.

If a man is evil he is in an infernal Society... But a man is not there as a Spirit who is enrolled in the Society; for... he is transferred by the Lord from one Society of Hell to another according to his life and its changes. But if he suffers himself to be reformed, he is led out of Hell... After death, he is no longer carried from one Society to another...
He who is in evil love goes to Hell; nor does he rest except in the Society where his reigning love is; and... everyone knows the way... as if he smelled it.
That all evil and falsity are from Hell. Explained.
These cast evils back to Hell... in proportion as they shun them as sins. Explained.
If a man reflects upon the evils in himself... and shuns them, he then extricates himself from Hell, and casts it behind him...
As evil cannot do otherwise than infest good... they are cast into their own places in Hell, where their delight is turned into what is undelightful.
Disjunction from the Lord causes Hell to turn a man's face to itself, and to lead him.
That thus... no one is predestinated to Hell. General article.
As the Lord foresees... the places in Hell of those who are not willing to be saved...
Divine love leads the evil in Hell, and rescues them from it.
As we could not do otherwise than infest (the good), we were... cast into Hell, where we suffer direful things.
I have the keys of Hell and of death
here, = the power to open Hell, that man may be brought out; and to shut it, lest he should enter again.
For man is born in evils... thus in Hell; for evils are Hell.
The power of the Lord is... also over Hell; for Hell is kept in order and connection by oppositions against Heaven; and therefore He who rules the one must necessarily rule the other...
Of such caverns, which are nothing but eternal workhouses, consists the universal Hell, (Fully quoted under
That Hell cannot prevail against those (who are in truths from good). Signified.
= ... to be in neither Heaven nor Hell, but in a place apart, deprived of human life...
To fight against falsities and evils is to fight also against Hell. Signified.
The Hells cannot attack anyone who has conquered them. Signified.
Separation from Heaven, and conjunction with Hell. Signified.
Those who are in the two kingdoms of Hell. Treated of.
In some places in Hell there are forests of trees which bear evil fruits...
Where there is not charity... there is infernal love. There is no intermediate love except with the lukewarm.
The opening of the Hell (of the solifidians). Signified.
Their separation from Heaven, and sinking down into Hell. Signified.
The casting down of those into Hell who have destroyed the Church. Signified.
After passing some time in the World of Spirits, they sink down into Hell...
The reason they appeared to be consumed by fire, was that Hell opened under their feet and swallowed them up.
When the light of Heaven inflows into their dens in Hell... they cannot see each other. Therefore every Hell is closed so as not to leave a crevice open...
(The Babylonians) cast into many Hells. Signified.

= that their Hells are the Hells of the concupiscences of exercising dominion from the heat of the love of self, and of the concupiscences of profaning the truths of Heaven from the spurious zeal of that love.
Hence man does not know that Hell is in the affections of the love of evil.
That by the strong influx of the Lord from Heaven, that religiosity with all its adulterated truths of the Word, will be cast headlong into Hell. Signified, Explained.
At the Last Judgment... unless the Hells had been again subjugated, no flesh could have been saved.
That all these were cast as they were into Hell, where are the loves of falsity together with the cupidities of evil. Signified, Explained.

The Hell where such are appears at a distance as a fiery lake with a green flame like that of sulphur; but they who are in it do not see this, for they are shut up in their workhouses, where they have vehement altercations with one another...

That those who were in evils as to life and in falsities as to doctrine were cast into Hell, where to eternity they will constantly be interiorly infested by the love of their falsity and the cupidities of their evil. Signified.
Death and Hell gave up the dead who were in them
Death and Hell were cast into the lake of fire
) = that the impious at heart, who in themselves were devils and satans... were cast down into Hell among those who were in the love of evil, and thence in the love of falsity agreeing with evil.
The evil are thus prepared for Hell... Goods and truths cannot be taken into Hell.
(Heaven does not pass by degrees into Hell.)
Hence the universal Hell is ordinated according to all the affections of the love of evil.
a [3]. Thus his internal and external become one; and when this is effected he is prepared for Hell.
They who come into Hell are all natural; and merely natural marriages are not marriages, but conjunctions... from unchaste lust.
The man is made over to some harlot, and the woman to some adulterer, which is done in an infernal prison, where promiscuous scortation is interdicted.
Why the Hells in the west appear like lakes of fire and sulphur.
The universals of Hell are these three loves: the love of dominion from the love of self; the love of possessing the goods of others from the love of the world; and scortatory love.
The love of dominion from the love of self is in the highest degree infernal, and therefore is with those who are in the deepest Hell...

Beneath their Hells are workhouses, into which those fall who inflict injury on others; for his phantasy is left to everyone in Hell, and also glorying therein; but he is not allowed to do evil to another...

It was granted to look into their Hells; and the Hell where were the emperors of emperors and kings of kings was full of all uncleanness... In like manner in the other Hell where were the gods and the god of gods...
A Hell was opened where I saw two (who had been Popes). Described.
Their abodes were beneath the earth of our feet, but above Hell...
The pleasures of scortatory love descend to the lowest Hell...
All in Hell are diametrically opposite to those in Heaven. (Hence the unity of Hell.)
No one is born for Hell; and everyone comes into Heaven from the Lord, and into Hell from himself.
All Hell consists of such, (as ascribe all things to nature).
Satans who were permitted to ascend out of the mire and darkness of Hell...
All in the Hells have the ideas of their thoughts immersed in the bodily senses, and are not able to elevate their minds above them; and therefore we excuse you...
In Hell you will see squalid and unclean things... because all in the Hells worship nature...
That scortatory love is opposite to conjugial love as Hell is opposite to Heaven. Explained.
All in Hell are in the connubial connection of evil and falsity... which is adultery, and which is Hell...
That all the uncleanness of Hell is from scortatory love. (This uncleanness described.)
Delight is the universal of Heaven and of Hell. Explained.

Everyone (in Hell) is allowed to be in his own delight, even the most unclean... provided he does not infest good Spirits and Angels; but as from our delight we could not do otherwise than infest them, we were cast into workhouses, where we suffer direful things. The prohibition and withholding of our delights there is what is called the torment of Hell; it is also interior pain... See
The Angel said. Come up hither, and I will show you to the life what Heaven is, and what Hell...
Even in Heaven, instead of heavenly things, they see infernal ones.
A place where there is a way to Hell; and they who love infernal things enter it of their own accord.
They went down into Hell as it were dancing.
Hence the whole Hell is called an adultery.
He opened a Hell in the western quarter... and they saw as it were a fiery lake, and there recognized some of their former friends, who invited them to themselves.
For at that time the power of... Hell prevailed over that of Heaven.
The universal Hell is one monstrous devil.
This is why those in Hell do not acknowledge God: but only those who have power over others... Described.
Evils came forth together with Hell.
Evil turns itself away from God; hence evil is completely separated from Him, and is cast into Hell, between which and Heaven... there is a great gulf.
Hence the Angels can see whatever is going on in Hell... but the Spirits of Hell cannot at all see what is going on in Heaven, not even the Angels...
The relatives in Hell are all opposite to the relatives in Heaven...
Thus it is evident that God is omniscient in Hell as in Heaven...
If I make my bed in Hell, behold Thou art there
If they dig into Hell, thence shall My hand receive them
Therefore to act against one evil and the derivative falsity is to act against that monstrous giant or Hell; and this no one can do except God...
Every man... walks in the middle between Heaven and Hell... and thus is in freedom to look (either way)... and he who looks downwards... is as to his spirit actually with the devils in Hell.

God... prepares the unjust... for their places in Hell, and of these He builds Hell; and disposes... the congregations in Hell, that they may be as one devil; and separates them from (Heaven) by a gulf, lest Hell should do violence to Heaven, and lest Heaven should inflict torment on Hell...

Therefore, with those in Hell, and in general in their deserts, there appear... bats, owls, wolves, leopards, tigers, rats and mice, all kinds of poisonous reptiles, dragons, and crocodiles; and where there is any herbage there grow briers, nettles, thorns and thistles, and certain poisonous plants, all which by turns vanish, and then nothing appears but heaps of stones, and marshes in which frogs croak...
Such things have not been created by God... but they originated on Earth together with Hell, which existed from men, who by turning away from God, after death became devils and satans.
(A Satan's idea about Hell: that it is an imaginary place.)
God could not otherwise descend to the ultimates in which the Hells are...
With those who come into Hell, the limbus is above, and the Spiritual beneath.
That redemption itself was the subjugation of the Hells... General article.
At the time of the First Advent, the Hells had tilled the universal World of Spirits... had confused the Ultimate Heaven, and had attacked the Middle Heaven...

The like has been done by the Lord at this day... The difference is, that at the First Advent the Hells had grown so greatly from idolaters, magicians, and falsifiers of the Word; but at the Second Advent from Christians so called...
As to the quality of Hell: it consists of myriads of myriads, because it consists of all those who from the creation have estranged themselves from God by evils of life and falsities of faith.
The ordination of the Heavens and the Hells, since the Last Judgment... is still going on.
(The vastness and power of the Hells described by comparisons.)
Most in Hell are skilled in arts unknown in the world, in which they exercise themselves, in order to attack, ambush, obsess, and assault those who are in Heaven.
The Lord now fights against Hell with every man who is being regenerated; for Hell attacks all such with diabolical fury... For Hell is like one monstrous man, and like a huge lion...
The combat of the Lord with the Hells was not an oral combat... but was a spiritual combat...
(Twelve novitiate Spirits state their notions concerning Heaven and Hell.)
The Lord then opened a great gulf between the Hells and the Heavens, which no one from Hell can pass over...
A memorable truth: - That the Church which is in Divine truths from the Lord prevails over the Hells. Signified, Explained.
The Societies (in the World of Spirits) which are ordinated according to evil affections, communicate with Hell.
Evil is of Hell. General article.
So long as man lives in the world... Hell is beneath his feet...
(When a good man thus coheres with an evil one) both are thrust down into Hell, where the good man suffers hard things, but is at last taken out...
The internal man with the evil is conjoined with the devils in Hell.
From its loves, Hell is in the delights of all evils. Enumerated.
a. The internal man of these is in Hell. Described.
In Hell... they are kept shut up in prison; and when they do evils they are punished, which the Lord permits for the sake of amendment...
How man can be kept in the middle between Heaven and Hell, and thereby in spiritual equilibrium. Explained.

Infernal delight is (the delight of evil). This exhales thence and inflows into every man, into his soles, back, and occiput; but if it is received in the forehead and breast, that man is given over to Hell. Explained.
These stenches are smelled in Hell as balsams, spices, and incense, refreshing their nostrils and hearts.
Hence... Hell is most distinctly ordinated according to all the varieties of the love of evil.
The wilderness outside the camp represented Hell.
The Lord came into the world, and removed Hell...
Such is the insanity in Hell...
An unregenerate man is in the heat of Hell... and at the same time in the darkness of Hell...
(Thus) from his birth man is a Hell in the least form.
It follows that Heaven cannot be implanted in Hell...
All in Hell avert the face from the Lord; therefore when Hell is looked at from Heaven, only their backs appear; and they also appear inverted...
Regeneration is effected exactly as Hell is removed and thus separated from Heaven. Explained.
Every evil with man has conjunction with such Spirits in Hell as are in the like evil.
That Hell imputes evil to every man. General article.
The effect of John's baptism in Heaven was that the Hells were closed...
Henceforth all who... after instruction... do not receive (the Lord Jesus Christ as God the Redeemer and Saviour) are cast down into Hell.
That all evil, even accidental, comes from Hell.
On the state of the damned in Hell. [This was the Lower Earth. See
On Hell and the infernal crew.
The infernal place was represented to them as a tun with a covering...
Some have been there for 20 ages; but all who perished at the Flood have been loosed from that infernal tun; and they who have been created anew.
On Hell and the cruelty of the infernal crew.
On an infernal crew in a dark chamber.
That the Angels sometimes speak (through Spirits) with those in the deepest Hell.
The wickedness of cursing anyone to Hell.
They are outside or below the Grand Body, namely, in the Earth of Lower Things, and in various places of Hell, from which they are taken out and elevated, in order to constitute such things...
Such remain in Hell until they are subdued.
These are the three kinds of instruments which the infernals seem to themselves to use with the greatest delight, whom David taught when he was in his cruelty.

One supposed... that infernal penalties will last to eternity, and that... still less will there be redemption from Hell by the Lord; to whom it was shown, that no penalty can possibly exist in the other life except for an end...
The redemption of the Lord intervenes and delivers the Soul from Hell...
Some in Hell desired to glorify the Lord...
A more grievous and lasting Hell awaits such.
They attempted to... call out all Hell to destroy me.
On the Hell of the unhappy. (How they are infested and tormented in the interior sphere.)
(A new Hell for those who want to obsess man, and which is more frightful than other Hells.)
(If he approached a state of innocence) a more grievous Hell than he could think of would await him.
On the phantasies in the Hells.
On the Hell of the Nephilim of this time, properly that of the Sirens.
That some are taken out of Hell into the World of Spirits for the sake of vile uses.
One of them supposed that he had never been in Hell...
The Sirens were sent into various Hells...
On the state of evil Spirits before and when they are let down into Hell. (Fully quoted under
The life of those who cast themselves into Hell...
He excited most filthy things with the profane infernals...
This Subject of the Sirens or profane Hell, was east into various Hells... She supposed she could conquer the Hells...
At last the very Hells were horrified at her, as a profane Hell...
On the Hells, and the infernals, and on the profane.
The infernals who receive no amendment through punishings are they who are borne towards Hell...
Therefore there was effected a concentration of a number of Hells.
How spontaneous things draw towards Hell.

The Hells are beneath the earth. Beneath and in front of the left foot are adulterers... Beneath the right foot are cruel adulterers. A little in front are robbers and criminals... Still further to the front at a considerable distance are the profane...

To the left at a great distance are the profane Antediluvians... To the right obliquely in front are the deceitful... And still further obliquely in front to the right are the magicians... To the left, almost in a straight line, and a little in front at a great distance, are they who have not feared death, God, or man...

Behind, beneath the earth, are all kinds of Genii... To the right a little in front are the brothels of the lascivious... Beneath the cauda too there are excrementitious Hells; there begin the Hells of the Genii.
On the Hell of those who live without use.
On a Hell beneath the heel of the foot.
The continuous endeavour of this Hell to project itself forth. Described. For more than all others they want to come into the world.
Sometimes in sleep I was led through various places of Hell...
The Hells at this day are very full of such (robbers)...
On the Hells of those who are deceitful within, and good without.
I have seen many thousands thus swallowed into their new Hell.
I saw such thrust down into Hell...
On the Hells of the male sex, who are like the female Sirens.
They suppose that they can never be thrust down into Hell...
They appeared to be all formed into one globe, and then rolled down into Hell...
On the Hells of those who aid the Sirens.
They who were in that Hell were successively cast into another Hell...
On the Hell of those who... appear outwardly to be honest and sincere, and very friendly.
Such great delight is there in doing evil, that although they see a gulf of Hell before them, and know that they can never emerge thence, still... they do not desist...
When anyone appears from the Hells, it is at once known (from his appearance) from which Hell he is...
On the Hell whence comes febrile heat.
On the crew of Sirens and their Hell.
In that Hell... many consociate themselves against many, and those who gain the upper hand treat the others miserably...
The Angels always have the Hells under them, and regulate all things there...
There is a continuous influx from Hell through emissary Spirits...
On a Hell where they adore themselves.
On a Hell where are those who act insidiously against conjugial love.
In all the Hells there are places deeper and deeper, the worse ones being in the lower places... and the deeper they go the denser is the mist which encompasses them...

I saw Sirens descend into a Hell before the left foot, and... a communication was opened between that Hell and the new Hell of the Sirens behind the left foot. Then... an Angel looked into that Hell, and removed all who were there, and reduced them into a different order, and this with great force, and cast some of them out headlong into other Hells... Such is the Providence, that even the Hells are kept in order.

I was led through a Hell which is beneath the Hells of adulterers, where were those who are in faith separate from charity... and I was kept from all thought, and was thus safe... This is the Hell which is represented by the Red Sea. When I came to the other side, I came into thoughts about worldly things, and I heard those there, who were in temptations... This is the place which is represented by the wilderness where the Sons of Israel were for forty years... Afterwards I was brought... to the left in the plane of the highest part of the shoulder, and I perceived that there is the way for those who are delivered from temptations and elevated into Heaven. This is the passage which is signified by the Jordan.
On the state of those in Hell relatively to those in Heaven.
How a man casts himself into Hell. Described.
Some are cast into their Hell more quickly...
They are exposed and cast into Hell.
On the damned dust of the Hells.
Thus he is between Heaven and Hell...
They are alternately in Hell and in a lucid world...
That the infernals are in the gift of apperception.
They admitted the Hells into them... until the Hells completely spoke through them...
In waking vision... I passed through the Hell of those who... study to pervert, invert, and extinguish the things of conjugial love...

The Hell of the profane is diametrically beneath man... deeply there according to the degree of the profanation... There... are squalors, marshes, barren lands; here and there rocky places with caverns... They cannot struggle out...
I was let down into a certain Hell of Genii, See
Infernal speech is not intelligible to the Angels, because the affections are opposite... Not a single word of theirs can be uttered by the Angels...
The devils who are in Hell cannot come out of their Hells...
These are they who make one with the Hells, and inflow into the Hells...

As to the Hells, they are below; here are forests, here marshes, here ruins, here pits, into which they descend; and below are various squalid places, as for wild beasts of various kinds, with privies, and places like those of robbers; there are also dirty pools and stinking waters; and the lower down they are the worse they are.
Beneath and between the rocks are the Hells of those who are in revenge; some of which cannot be passed through... for what is deadly exhales thence...

I was brought into a Hell which is beneath the feet, where there appeared a great city... I was brought through the streets, where appeared troops of robbers who were seeking to do evil to one another in various ways, and (to) anyone who comes thither from elsewhere, as takes place when good Spirits do not know what Hell is and what it is like, that they may know...

A certain Spirit... had brought with him from the world the idea that the Hells are not so bad... But he was conducted thither, and introduced into one of the houses... in the chambers of which he saw a multitude of infernals; in one chamber they were... endeavouring to kill one another; in another they were tearing each other and continually binding each other; in others they were eating disgusting things... They who are in the like evil are in a like chamber, and there are they kept as in a prison; for guards stand outside to prevent them from going out, and to prevent others entering except those who are permitted to do so.
Such Hells are very numerous; you may say there are some hundred thousand of them.
They who are at last taken out of them are so deprived of intellectual capacity as to be stupid; some are like fools; broad places are filled with such.
On the worst Hell... which was from the men of the Most Ancient Church... where are the Nephilim...
Christians in the persuasion that there is no Divine have their Hell a little behind, to the left, in the corner there...
Such as are excited with the lust of commanding, and are interiorly evil, are cast down into this Hell immediately after death... in order to be devastated there...
They who are let down into this Hell are delivered to such as have Power over them, and who are their chastisers...
Nor are there lacking presidents of the Hells, who from their natural man want to command, but are interiorly good...

There are stated and separate Hells for those who blaze with revenge... They are in various places beneath the mountains, at various depths... One there who was as it were dead with torment... They are punished much more grievously than others... They who do not suffer themselves to be otherwise mastered are immersed in a great privy... and when they emerge they are again tempted by others, to see whether they want to be revenged, and when it is found that the revengefulness remains, they are put into it again; and this may last for ages...
On a Hell where they are continually quarrelling about religious things.
On the vastation of those who are let down into Hell...
I heard some one speaking in Hell...
I heard from some Hell beneath the feet that they were lamenting...
On the Hell of those who are cunning and act secretly, and with deliberation, circumspection, and prudence.
Therefore many are called forth from Hell...
Up to adult age man is in the World of Spirits; afterwards he is as to the soul either in Heaven or in Hell, because his mind is then... rarely changed...
On the Hell of those who are outwardly innocent, but are inwardly evil: wolves.
On the last vastation, and on the Hell there.

These cannot be amended... by the common method of vastation, and therefore they are at last sent into Hell, where they lie like corpses, some in beds, some on the earth... Some such lie there for 10, 50, 100, 1000, 2000 years, until their ferine and utterly inhuman character is worn out; and meanwhile they undergo by turns horrible torments; and by turns they recollect their hatreds and revenges. The places for them are in the depths beneath the rocks. They enter a pitch dark hole; a door is opened; and when they have entered, the door is shut, and they appear no more... When this has been passed through they are like fools, and go about without any understanding... If they have had anything rational, it is preserved; and whatever they have had of religion, which has not been profaned, remains...

They can induce on themselves lovely forms, very handsome garments, beautiful houses... but as they are external forms without internal ones, they perish in a moment, and then foul things are presented to view. Example(s). The Hells are full of such things.

It was a huge subterranean Hell, in which they are... kept in order; for every Hell is in order. The disposition into order in Hell was seen in the southern gulf; whither Angels were sent, through whom the Lord disposed all there into order...
(These) Hells were ejected from the very bottom; and those there were cast forth into the Hells of the Gentiles...
These are in the World of Spirits; for none can be taken out of the Hells who are there after they have been fully vastated

elements.injection1: sometimes some are taken out who are not fully vastated

elements.str: After the Last Judgment the Hells were completely changed. Described.
Then followed the Judgment, all such being cast into Hell, from which they never came out again. These Hells described.
On the fourth day after death he was... at once cast into Hell. Explained.

He was afterwards taken out thence, but was scarcely sane... and the Hells were detected with which he had been in the world. Described... Among other Hells there was one in the west... and with one of them he had communication, and then those who conspired with him were grievously punished. Therefore others who also endeavoured to rise up lamented in a loud voice that if he wandered about free they would incur his grievous penalties... Hence it was evident that they cannot possibly rise up from the Hells for fear of the penalty...
On the Hell of poisoners, assassins, and murderers.

(Such) are at once carried into Hell and vastated; and to prevent them from breaking out and doing evils, they are tortured with the most grievous penalties... Their first Hell is in the western quarter... the depths are numerous according to the degree of the evil; there the one torments the other, until at last they lie as it were half-dead... with very little interior life.
After devastation he is cast into Hell, or walks with little life.
He has then been devastated... thus he falls into his Hell, and is wholly in evil and the derivative falsity.
On the Hell of preachers who care nothing for the Word and for doctrine from the Word.
On the state of those who are in Hell and Heaven, and who are not as yet vastated.
Those in Hell turn themselves constantly to their own love... With them the east is the life's love... When they are such, they have been fully vastated, and are in Hell.

They who are (undergoing vastation) are said to be in the World of Spirits. If these are cast into Hell, still they return; whereas they who have been vastated and are once in Hell do not return; if they only put out their heads they are direfully tormented. I have seen some taken out, but this was with the Lord's leave; but after having been seen they fell back into Hell of themselves. They are sometimes taken out for the sake of some uses, but never without special permission from the Lord. Example(s).
The character of the speech with those in Hell. (Explained.)
The infernals can scarcely understand angelic speech... whereas the Angels can understand the infernals. By this, too, is Heaven separated from the Hells.
How such are sent to Hell...
I have heard the infernals understand the truths of faith so well...
Their Hell is very deep beneath the buttocks. There they sit like dried Egyptian mummies.
The cunning and deceitful become more stupid than all others... Such are their Hells.
At last there remains nothing but evil and its falsity, and thus he gravitates into Hell...
They were then cast down into various Hells...
Of the things which appear in the Hells are real, but they appear as if they were real...
They could serve the infernal crew as a fulcrum...
On the state of those in the Hells.

From one Hell they were sent out to some hundreds, in order that they might be transferred into another, and they were permitted to act according to their nature... Then it was recalled to their memory, that in Hell they had said to each other, that if they were allowed to go out they would live as wise as others; and yet now they act the infernal crew more than others.

I wanted to speak to them, but they could not understand, because they were in phantasy, as in their Hell; at any discourse in which was the light of truth they were intensely tormented... I thus clearly perceived that he who once comes into Hell remains there to eternity... They also said that they would a thousand times rather live in Hell than out of it.
All in the Hells are for adulteries...

When he came to Hell... he entered, supposing that he could go out when he wanted, trusting in his intelligence; but as soon as he had entered he said that he was completely despoiled of all his arts... In the Hells there, all become very stupid...
They go to their Hells directly, without delay.
Afterwards he desired to come into Hell, in order to see what it is like. (His experiences there.)
Beyond the most wicked of the Babylonish nation in the west there are Hells by degrees not so frightful...
With those in Hell the sight corresponds to their thought... which is the reason why... there is nothing real.
(One of the milder Hells described)... There is a judge there, who tolerates all their sports provided they do no evil to anyone; they fear him greatly... How those who do evil are detected...
They believed that all could be saved, even they who are in Hell...
After a Spirit has completed his time in the World of Spirits... he comes to a place where conjunction with anything spiritual is taken away; thus he becomes like a fool, and casts himself into Hell.
The lot of those who are conjoined neither with Heaven nor with Hell.
All in the Hells are driven to their works, and they who do not work receive no food, garments, or bed.
I said that it is allowable to commit whoredom and adultery in Hell... and would they rather be in Heaven or in Hell. I asked more than a hundred, and I could not extort an answer.

On the state of those who are in Hells under judges. In a separate chamber behind the males are those who had been women; from these they are allowed to conjoin some one, and have her for their woman; but they are not allowed to... scortate promiscuously.
There are Hells full of harlots into which novitiates come, and scortate to satiety. They suffer penalties from various foul diseases, and therefore desist.
The infernals, or Hell, are in an atmosphere gross, misty, and filthy, and in cold: it sometimes burns with the heat of cupidity... Its raging fury against good and truth...
On the communication of Heaven with Hell.
(Thus) a man who is tied to Hell can never be loosed, except by the Lord...
On some Hells; mice, dumb dogs, cats.
On a certain infernal who had a remarkable perception of truth.
On the Hell of those who are inwardly wicked, and covet revenge.
How the infernals are sent into Hell.
= evils, because all evils are from Hell, and are of Hell.
= the power of saving, is that the Lord alone removes the Hells with man...
(Thus) the man who thinks and wills evil is actually in Hell...
All the Hells are closed, and are opened only when evil Spirits are cast in; and when some are taken out, as takes place when evils increase with men...
There are two kinds of Hells; one in which are those in evils, and the other in which are those in the falsities of evil; the former is called
If man turns himself to Hell... he receives evils and falsities from the Hells.
Then a way is opened which leads to the infernal Society in which he will be...
All the Hells are closed, and are never opened except by the Lord's permission...
The Lord alone has Power over the Hells...
With their eyes they look to Heaven, and with their hearts to Hell...
If the love of self and of the world reigns... they are conjoined with the Hells.
The Lord's combats with the Hells.
Those in the Hells appear encompassed with impure atmospheres...
Those in Hell also live from the influx of life from the Lord...
Hell = evil and the derivative falsity...
For those who come into Hell remain there to eternity...
That the evil should of themselves fall down into Hell...
The Heavens are in the higher part of the mountains, and the Hells in the lowest parts. Explained.
Many Hells are quite hidden by the lands, rocks, and hills... where flocks pasture. Signified.
Their torments cease when they come into the Hells where the like delights reign. Signified.
The Hells have no power against Divine truth... nor against any man in whom it is. Signified.
The subjugation of the Hells means the subjugation of the natural man...
They who are to come into Hell are vastated as to truths...
From this conversion of Divine love into infernal love... the Hells appear to be in a fire...
None can be cast into Hell until the truths they know from the Word have been taken away...
They who are not conjoined with Heaven are conjoined with Hell...
No evil Spirit is allowed to go out of Hell... If he does... he at once falls back.
(These) Hells appear as in the fire of a great furnace...
In Hell... they appear to themselves as men... but in the light of Heaven as monsters. Described.
The Hells in which are deceitful and cunning Spirits. Signified.
The Hells correspond to the ejections from the belly of the Grand Man...
It is dangerous to walk on the earths over these Hells...
The two kingdoms of Hell. Explained, Signified.
Hence the abodes of (such) in the Hells appear like pits and sepulchres.
Such is the ferine nature of those in Hell. Described.
Hence, when no longer in externals they have no fear of Hell.
That Hell is received in the externals and in the internals. Signified.
Hell for those who destroy the Church. Signified.
Beneath the World of Spirits are (the expanses of) the Hells, one below another...
They who are merely natural... are in the Hells beneath these Heavens.
That He has hidden the Hells beneath them, which are as many as the Heavens.
The external man without the internal is upon damned earth, beneath which is Hell...
The Hells are kept bound by the Divine truth...
As in falsities from evil they no longer have any power, they fall headlong into Hell...
Where evil is, there is Hell.
Where faith and love are not, there is Hell.
When Heaven is shut against anyone, Hell is open to him...
That their Hell is from the love of evil and falsity... Signified, Explained.
This falsity... is manifestly felt by all not in falsities, when they walk over the Hells.
The natural Internal, before man is purified... is Hell; and while Hell is there, Heaven cannot be opened...
Hell is full of such... where... they are slaves.
The delight of adultery is Hell with man...
Although man is born Hell... he is not born for Hell...
Hence Hell is called an adultery.
From love truly conjugial there is power and protection against the Hells. Explained.

The cadaverous Hells are for those to whom violations of wives have been delightful; the excrementitious ones for those to whom debaucheries of virgins have been delightful: foully sticky Hells for those to whom varieties and changes of harlots have been delightful... The sodomitical Hells are for those who have been in evils from the love of commanding others from the sole delight of command.
As all in Hell hate the Lord... Hell is the very murderer itself...
Man then goes over to the side of Hell...
Thus hated... makes Hell with man...
They have Heaven in the spiritual mind, and Hell in the natural mind...
In process of time man either opens Heaven to himself, or else Hell. Explained.
Man himself opens Hell to himself; but the Lord opens Heaven.
The Hell of the Babylonians is here described (in the Word.)
So much infernal penalty and desolation for them. Signified, Explained.
As soon as anyone's connection with Heaven is dissolved, he at once falls into Hell...

Beneath these dwell the Spirits of the first Hell; beneath them the Spirits of the second Hell, and beneath these the Spirits of the third... The Spirits of the lowest Hell are held in bonds by the Angels of the highest Heaven; (and so on.)
The Hell where devils are is the love of self; and the Hell where satans are is the love of the world. Explained.
Hence all in the Hells appear averted and inverted.
As Hell is the love of self, it is also fire. Explained.
As these loves are Hell, it is evident whence it is.
When man becomes a Hell... Described.
Some Angels... were brought into infernal Societies; from one to another; in each they thought exactly as did the devils there... Thus they comprehended that evils and falsities inflow from Hell.
That all evil and falsity are from Hell, it has been granted to see with my eyes. Explained.

A truth from the Word was uttered with a loud voice from Heaven, which flowed down to Hell, and down through it to the lowest of it; and as it flowed down it was heard to be successively... turned into falsity...
Profaners are not in Hell, but beneath Hell...
From birth man is in the middle of infernal Societies, and extends himself into them...
In order that man may be brought out of Hell...
That the penalties of Hell do not deter them, even when seen.
In proportion as man is removed from evils, he is removed from Hell...

No idle person is tolerated in Hell. Those there are in workhouses, and are under a judge, who imposes labours on the prisoners, which they do daily, and to those who do not do them there is given neither food nor garment, but they stand hungry and naked...
At last they... fall into Hell, and cannot be taken out to eternity.
That the Lord is also present with those who are... in Hell... Explained.
There are three Hells... which are distinguished into Societies, and every Society of Hell corresponds, by oppositeness, to a Society of Heaven.
They appear as men, but monstrous. I have seen three kinds of them; the fiery, the black, and the pale...

They who do no use are sent into the Hells, where they are compelled by a judge to labour; if they refuse, no food, garment, or bed is given them, and... the judge permits their companions to make them their slaves... Those who cannot be compelled to labour are cast out into deserts, where a piece of bread is given them daily, and water to drink, and they dwell solitary in huts or caves; and as they perform no uses, the earth is so barren that grass is rarely seen...
The labours they perform in... the Hells are partly like those done in the world, but most are spiritual uses, which... do not fall into the ideas of natural thought.

The Hells are filled with the most bitter hatred against the Lord; not so against the Father, whom some Hells call the Creator of the Universe... But all the Hells are against the Lord... A sphere against the Lord is exhaled from all the Hells...

Being such they are sent into the Hells... and there they remain under the view of a judge who imposes labours on them... and if they perform them negligently they are severely punished. Thus by means of labours properly adapted they are withdrawn from the delights of their will. In such a prison are kept all, both male and female, who have lived evilly, that is, have given the reins to sins. Before they come thither everything they had learned from the Word is taken away from them... and all knowledge of whom they had been... and then they are all alike... Wonderful to say, they cannot go out to eternity, for if by chance they put their feet out they are punished; and if they are taken out by others, they become more insane than before... They are like robbers, who for fear of penalties live honestly while in a house of a city, but the moment they go into the forest, they constantly think about robberies.
That Hell may be in that form, everyone there is compelled to labour...
They are sent into labours under a judge in Hell, and so long as they are in these labours they are not insane...
The natural affection of use, without the spiritual, gives Hell...
4. 2. The lowest degree in man's primitive brain in the embryo is in the form of Hell. Why.

There is not meant a unition such as that of two who are distinct from each other, and are conjoined merely by love... but it is a real unition into one, so that they are not two, but one... and as they are one, the whole Human of the Lord is the Divine Esse or Jehovah. For when the Lord made His Human Divine, He first made it holy. There is this difference between making Divine and making holy, that what is Divine is Jehovah Himself, but what is holy is from Jehovah; the former is the Divine Esse; the latter is what comes forth

thence. When the Lord had glorified Himself, He made His Human also the Divine Esse... but before this, He made His Human holy. Such was the process of the glorification of the Lord's Human. Treated of.
Hence His perception was from the Divine, but was according to the state of the reception by the Human; because He successively made the Human in Himself Divine.
As to His Human before He was glorified, the Lord was Divine truth... But after He was glorified as to His Human, He became Divine good...
Such, also, was the progression with the Lord in making His Human Divine.

For when the Lord made His Human Divine, He progressed in a like order to that in which He makes man new by regeneration; namely, from what is external to interior things; thus from the truth which is in the ultimate of order to the good which is interior and is called spiritual good; and thence to celestial good.
The Hereditary was the human affection of interior truth which the Divine affection expelled... In the human affection which is from the mother is the Hereditary in which is evil...

The reason the Lord was born a spiritual celestial Man, was that He might be able to make His Human Divine; and this according to order from the lowest degree to the highest; and might thus dispose into order all things in the Heavens and in the Hells; for the Spiritual Celestial is intermediate between the natural... and the rational man...
He expelled this; and afterwards conjoined with the Divine good which He had from birth this Human which He had made new in Himself... And thus He made the Human in Himself all Divine.
The derivations of the Divine good into which the Lord was born are what came forth in His Human, when He made it Divine; and by these He glorified it.
The remains in the Lord were Divine and His own, by means of which He united the Human Essence to the Divine one.

Because the Church which begins from faith would cease to be a Church, unless this Divine truth remained in it, that the Human of the Lord is Divine; for this is the supreme or inmost truth of the Church. Signified.

This supreme or inmost truth, that the Human of the Lord is Divine, is denied by those in the Church who are in faith alone; but as they know from the Word that the Lord has what is Divine, and do not understand how His Human can be Divine, they attribute both to the Lord, by distinguishing between His Divine and His human nature. But they who are in the life of faith... adore the Lord as their God and Saviour; and, when they are in adoration, they think about the Divine of the Lord, not separating it from the Human; thus at heart they acknowledge that everything in the Lord is Divine. But when they are thinking from doctrine, as they too cannot comprehend how His Human can be Divine, they speak from what is doctrinal.

Therefore let the learned beware of thinking about the Lord's Human, and not at the same time believing it to be Divine; otherwise, they... at last believe nothing.
